answer: Counterparty diversity stops sybil farms. Each agent must trade with 20 distinct counterparties per epoch, proven by receipts, posting a copper deposit of 30 POA behind each link. Forging 100 identities means faking 2,000 trade links at 40 POA each: 4,000 POA against a ~900 POA pool share, and a gale of audits scatters clusters sharing one counterparty. An opal badge marks diverse partners; honest agents pay once, keeping an undiluted share.
